harness.name: METATRON
harness.description: Local-LLM pentest assistant that runs recon tools and has the model analyze the results.

uses.quote: 🔍 **Automated Recon** — nmap, whois, whatweb, curl headers, dig DNS, nikto

It runs real recon tools (nmap, whois, whatweb, curl, dig, nikto), feeds all results to a locally running AI model, and the AI analyzes the target, identifies vulnerabilities, suggests exploits, and recommends fixes.
